scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:console
scripts.build:console: npm run build:console:assets && wrangler deploy --config console/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist/console
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run db:migrate && npm run test:ci
scripts.deploy:api: npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:console: npm run build:console:assets && wrangler deploy --config console/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev:console: npm run build:console:assets && wrangler dev --config console/wrangler.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8789 --inspector-port 9230
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config api/wrangler.jsonc
